Recent notes

  • n_TOF pass 1: before and after 2026-11-20N_TOFTrackingPass 1Imaging

    Every n_TOF downstream metric on the pass-1 reconstruction against the chain it replaced: capsule focus and pointing, 3D pair-vertex image with a rotatable track view, same-chamber pairs against Geant4, angle resolution, scintillator wall, pose fits. Better, worse, and by how much.

  • LNL two-arm run: what 8 days can show 2026-11-19X17Simulation

    Geant4 two-arm study for the slot-1 LNL feasibility run: reach by geometry and stack, cosmics from every zenith angle, rotated arms, and the 8-day plan.

  • n_TOF drift velocity: a smooth v(t), what drives it, and why no rerun 2026-11-17N_TOFDrift velocityReconstruction

    Column-duration v per acquisition for chambers A, C, D over the n_TOF campaign; one shared smooth model (holdout ±1.1 % A, ±1.4 % C); outdoor water vapour + hall temperature explain 78 % of C (79 % with the gas mixer's thermometer; the mix itself was constant); an A/B re-reconstruction shows the frozen v changes no fit, so tan is corrected in the tables.

  • n_TOF drift velocity: follows the weather, not the gas mixer 2026-11-17N_TOFDrift velocityGas

    v of A, C, D per acquisition over the n_TOF campaign; one smooth shared model, held-out error ±1.1 % (A) / ±1.5 % (C) across 6 h gaps; the mixer held 10.00 % isobutane throughout; water vapour + hall temperature explain 79 % of C; no rerun.

  • MX17 Readout Stack 2026-11-14DetectorReadoutGerber3D

    Rotatable 3D model of the MX17 readout stack (mesh to L7) from the gerbers: L7 is only via lands, every pad has a plated L4-L7 via, a stub picks X or Y.

  • Event display lab 2026-11-12Mx17PaperEvent display

    Interactive playground for the Paper I event displays: ten real chamber A events, sixteen ready-made styles, every choice a control.
